mechanism_narrative: The 6.3-point week-on-week improvement in TRANSIT from -44.6 to -38.3 marks the suppression trough passing; as transit use rebuilds, trip-chained discretionary visits recover and raise RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -44.6 at t-1w to -38.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its trailing 28-day mean in more than half of weeks where TRANSIT improved at least 5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL exceeds +8 percent change from baseline, households are sheltering and discretionary trips are cancelled; RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks stays below the trailing four-week mean.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean crosses above +8 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL hit 8.9 at t-1w, its highest of the four weeks
failure_condition: Following any week with RESIDENTIAL above +8, the next 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly depressed WORKPLACES at -20.1 and TRANSIT at -38.3 remove the commuter footfall that retail precincts depend on; while neither series clears its threshold, RETAIL_REC drifts lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES below -20 and TRANSIT below -35 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES last three weeks are -12.6, -22.4, -20.1 while TRANSIT is -35.7, -44.6, -38.3
failure_condition: In weeks where WORKPLACES is below -20 and TRANSIT below -35, forward 28-day RETAIL_REC is at or above the trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, a RESIDENTIAL rise of more than one point week-on-week combined with falling TRANSIT forces further cancellation of discretionary visits, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises more than 1 point week-on-week while TRANSIT falls week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:from t-2w to t-1w RESIDENTIAL rose 5.1 to 8.9 as TRANSIT fell -35.7 to -44.6 and RETAIL_REC fell -6.7 to -15.3
failure_condition: In tightening weeks defined by rising RESIDENTIAL and falling TRANSIT, the subsequent 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than the preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM holding within about two points of baseline while RETAIL_REC sits at -10.4 shows essential errands remain intact; routine in-person trips anchor basket spillover into adjacent retail, lifting RETAIL_REC within the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the 7 days after any week with GROCERY_PHARM at or above 0 falls relative to the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS improving 15.7 points week-on-week from -43.7 to -28.0 marks the mid-winter outdoor trough passing; better outdoor conditions raise overall out-of-home activity and pull RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises at least 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved -43.7 at t-1w to -28.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: After any week with PARKS up 10 points or more, the following 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is below the preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in PARKS and TRANSIT signals a broad release of pent-up trip demand; the outdoor and commuting channels reinforce one another and accelerate RETAIL_REC recovery over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves more than 10 points and TRANSIT improves more than 5 points in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:both PARKS and TRANSIT improved in the t-1w to t-0w step
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS gains over 10 points and TRANSIT over 5 points together, forward 14-day RETAIL_REC is lower than trailing 14-day RETAIL_REC.

mechanism_narrative: A RETAIL_REC print of -15.3 or lower confirms discretionary demand is running far below baseline; that level of avoidance persists rather than mean-reverting, so the forward four-week mean stays under the trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC prints at or below -15 in any week
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC hit -15.3 at t-1w, the lowest of the four weeks
failure_condition: After a week with RETAIL_REC at or below -15, the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is equal to or greater than the prior 28-day mean.
